entities.name: Church of Blessed Virgin Mary of Consolation, Vilnius

entities.summary: Church of the Blessed Virgin Mary of Consolation is a Roman Catholic church in the Vilnius Old Town which was built by the Augustinians in 1746–1768. It is the last landmark of the Vilnian Baroque architectural style.
